verdict.rationale: Runtime probes confirm that 1password.dev serves llms.txt and llms-full.txt, and that every docs page has a working .md mirror. support.1password.com also serves its own llms.txt of support guides. A public, keyless docs MCP server at 1password.dev/mcp completed an initialize handshake and is described on an 'ai-readable-docs' page. Missing for 10: independent community or user corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and in-depth first-party documentation content in the pack beyond the probe summaries.
